title: Mitigating the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Adaptive Train Scheduling with Curriculum-Driven Continual DQN Expansion
abstract: arXiv:2408.09838v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A continual learning agent builds on previous experiences to develop increasingly complex behaviors by adapting to non-stationary and dynamic environments while preserving previously acquired knowledge. However, scaling these systems presents significant challenges, particularly in balancing the preservation of previous policies with the adaptation of new ones to current environments. This balance, known as the stability-plasticity dilemma, is especially pronounced in complex multi-agent domains such as the train scheduling problem, where environmental and agent behaviors are constantly changing, and the search space is vast. In this work, we propose addressing these challenges in the train scheduling problem using curriculum learning. We design a curriculum with adjacent skills that build on each other to improve generalization performance. translated_abstract: 持续学习智能体通过适应非平稳和动态环境，在保留先前获得的知识的基础上积累经验，从而发展出日益复杂的行为。然而，扩展这些系统面临重大挑战，特别是在保留先前策略与使新策略适应当前环境之间取得平衡。这种平衡被称为稳定性-可塑性困境，在复杂的多智能体领域（如列车调度问题）中尤为明显，因为在此类问题中环境和智能体行为不断变化，且搜索空间庞大。在这项工作中，我们提出使用课程学习来解决列车调度问题中的这些挑战。我们设计了一个由相邻技能组成的课程，这些技能相互叠加构建，以提高泛化性能。引入具有不同任务的课程会带来非平稳性，我们通过……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出使用课程驱动的持续DQN扩展方法来缓解自适应列车调度中的稳定性-可塑性困境，通过设计技能相互叠加的课程学习来提升智能体的泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes curriculum-driven continual DQN expansion to mitigate the stability-plasticity dilemma in adaptive train scheduling, designing a curriculum of adjacent skills that build on each other to improve the agent's generalization performance.
